name: Jesus
bio: Jesus Christ, descended from Abraham and David through Joseph's line, was conceived by the Holy Spirit and born to Mary while she was engaged to Joseph. An angel instructed Joseph to name him Jesus, "for he will save his people from their sins," fulfilling the ancient prophecy of a virgin-born son called Immanuel, "God with us" (Matthew 1:1-25). His birth, ministry, death, and resurrection are told in full across the four Gospels.
